description: Support/sales operations workspace for triaging inbound demo requests from Intercom against a scheduling-eligibility policy, matching contacts and companies, and preparing a demo scheduling plan for manager review before any calendar booking or notification.

ss_demo_policy.content: Demo Scheduling Eligibility Policy (Sheet ID ss_demo_policy, tab 'Tier Rules'). Row 1: Qualifies if company is on a paid plan OR self-reported annual deal value >= $25,000. Row 2: Enterprise tier (deal value >= $100,000) gets priority slots within 48h. Row 3: Free-tier contacts with deal value < $25,000 are routed to self-serve and do NOT qualify for a live demo. Row 4: Requesters flagged 'student' or 'personal use' are excluded. Row 5: Max 2 demo slots per company per week.

tools.description: Look up an individual Intercom contact record (role, plan, self-reported deal value, flags) for a requester.

tools.name: lookup_requester_company
tools.description: Look up the Intercom company record (plan, seats, MRR, renewal, account owner) associated with a requester.

tools.description: Read the demo scheduling eligibility policy spreadsheet to determine which requesters qualify for a live demo.

tools.name: find_open_demo_slots
tools.description: Find available open slots on the Sales Demo calendar for proposing demo times.

tools.name: draft_demo_scheduling_plan
tools.description: Compile a draft scheduling plan listing each qualifying requester, their company, deal value (verbatim from source), and a proposed open calendar slot, for the user to review before anything is booked or sent.

tools.description: Create a confirmed, detailed event on the Sales Demo calendar with attendees, locking in a demo booking.
